explanation.value: Build an adjacency map from each source node to its list of targets. Run a BFS from start with a seen set. When a dequeued node has no entry in the map it is a sink: record it. Otherwise enqueue its unseen neighbours. Sort the sinks numerically at the end. The seen set makes cycles, duplicates and self loops harmless.
